# Catalonia Crop Fields (Mapa de cultius)

Catalonia field boundaries (2024) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Catalonia Department of Agriculture, Livestock, Fisheries and Food. License: other.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cat/latest/es_cat.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cat/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:25831; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: crop:name_en, geometry, crop:name, metrics:area, id, crop:code, collection, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cat/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cat/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cat/collection.json
